name: Bulk QR Code Generator
desc: Create many QR codes from a list of links, download as ZIP
seoTitle: Bulk QR Code Generator: Many QR Codes to ZIP
seoDescription: Create many QR codes at once. Paste a list of links or text, one per line, choose a size and download all QR codes as PNG files in one ZIP. Free.
intro: Turn a list of links, product pages or text into a set of QR codes in one go. Paste one item per line, choose the image size and error correction level, then download all the PNG files together as a ZIP.
steps: Paste your links or text, one per line.
Choose the image size and error correction (Medium is a good default).
Click Preview to check a few codes.
Download all QR codes as a ZIP.

faq.q: How many QR codes can I create?
Which error correction level should I pick?
faq.a: Medium suits most uses. Choose High if you plan to put a logo over the code or print on rough surfaces.
